name: Create a Team
description: Create a Team Create a new Team under your account. POST /v1/teams
context:
POST /v1/teams
Create a new Team under your account. You need to send a POST request with the desired Team slug, and optionally the Team name.
Required: body (body)

name: Delete a microfrontends group
description: Delete a microfrontends group Deletes a microfrontends group from the team associated with the group ID. DELETE /v1/teams/{teamId}/microfrontends/{groupId}
context:
DELETE /v1/teams/{teamId}/microfrontends/{groupId}
Deletes a microfrontends group from the team associated with the group ID.
Required: groupId (path) — The microfrontend group ID to delete.; teamId (path) — The Team identifier to perform the request on behalf of.
Optional: slug (query) — The Team slug to perform the request on behalf of.

name: Delete a Team
description: Delete a Team Delete a team under your account. DELETE /v1/teams/{teamId}
context:
DELETE /v1/teams/{teamId}
Delete a team under your account. You need to send a `DELETE` request with the desired team `id`. An optional array of reasons for deletion may also be sent.
Required: teamId (path) — The Team identifier to perform the request on behalf of.; body (body)
Optional: newDefaultTeamId (query) — Id of the team to be set as the new default team; slug (query) — The Team slug to perform the request on behalf of.

name: Delete a Team invite code
description: Delete a Team invite code Delete an active Team invite code. DELETE /v1/teams/{teamId}/invites/{inviteId}

name: Get a Team
description: Get a Team Get information for the Team specified by the `teamId` parameter. GET /v2/teams/{teamId}
context:
GET /v2/teams/{teamId}
Get information for the Team specified by the `teamId` parameter.
Required: teamId (path) — The Team identifier to perform the request on behalf of.
Optional: slug (query)

name: Get access request status
description: Get access request status Check the status of a join request. GET /v1/teams/{teamId}/request/{userId}

name: List team members
description: List team members Get a paginated list of team members for the provided team. GET /v3/teams/{teamId}/members
context:
GET /v3/teams/{teamId}/members
Get a paginated list of team members for the provided team.
Required: teamId (path) — The Team identifier to perform the request on behalf of.
Optional: limit (query) — Limit how many teams should be returned; since (query) — Timestamp in milliseconds to only include members added since then.; until (query) — Timestamp in milliseconds to only include members added until then.; search (query) — Search team members by their name, username, and email.; role (query) — Only return members with the specified team role.; excludeProject (query) — Exclude members who belong to the specified project.; eligibleMembersForProjectId (query) — Include team members who are eligible to be members of the specified project.; slug (query) — The Team slug to perform the request on behalf of.

name: List all teams
description: List all teams Get a paginated list of all the Teams the authenticated User is a member of. GET /v2/teams
context:
GET /v2/teams
Get a paginated list of all the Teams the authenticated User is a member of.
Optional: limit (query) — Maximum number of Teams which may be returned.; since (query) — Timestamp (in milliseconds) to only include Teams created since then.; until (query) — Timestamp (in milliseconds) to only include Teams created until then.

name: Invite a user
description: Invite a user Invite a user to join the team specified in the URL. POST /v2/teams/{teamId}/members
context:
POST /v2/teams/{teamId}/members
Invite a user to join the team specified in the URL. The authenticated user needs to be an `OWNER` in order to successfully invoke this endpoint. The user to be invited must be specified by email.
Required: teamId (path) — The Team identifier to perform the request on behalf of.
Optional: slug (query) — The Team slug to perform the request on behalf of.; body (body)

name: Join a team
description: Join a team Join a team with a provided invite code or team ID. POST /v1/teams/{teamId}/members/teams/join
context:
POST /v1/teams/{teamId}/members/teams/join
Join a team with a provided invite code or team ID.
Required: teamId (path); body (body)

name: List all flags for a team
description: List all flags for a team Retrieve all feature flags for a team across all projects. GET /v1/teams/{teamId}/feature-flags/flags
context:
GET /v1/teams/{teamId}/feature-flags/flags
Retrieve all feature flags for a team across all projects. The list can be filtered by state and supports pagination.
Required: teamId (path) — The Team identifier to perform the request on behalf of.
Optional: state (query) — The state of the flags to retrieve. Defaults to `active`.; withMetadata (query) — Deprecated. Whether to include creator metadata in each flag in the response. Resolve creator identity client-side (e.g. via the team members endpoint) instead; this parameter will be removed in a future release.; limit (query) — Maximum number of flags to return.; cursor (query) — Pagination cursor to continue from.; search (query) — Search flags by their slug or description. Case-insensitive.; kind (query) — The kind of flags to retrieve.; tags (query) — Filter flags by tag. Repeat the parameter for multiple tags (all must match).; slug (query) — The Team slug to perform the request on behalf of.

name: List team project flag settings
description: List team project flag settings Retrieve feature flag settings for projects in a team. GET /v1/teams/{teamId}/feature-flags/settings
context:
GET /v1/teams/{teamId}/feature-flags/settings
Retrieve feature flag settings for projects in a team.
Required: teamId (path) — The Team identifier to perform the request on behalf of.
Optional: limit (query) — Maximum number of settings to return.; cursor (query) — Pagination cursor to continue from.; slug (query) — The Team slug to perform the request on behalf of.

name: List all flags for a team
description: List all flags for a team Retrieve all feature flags for a team across all projects. GET /v2/teams/{teamId}/feature-flags/flags
context:
GET /v2/teams/{teamId}/feature-flags/flags
Retrieve all feature flags for a team across all projects. Returns an opaque cursor for pagination.
Required: teamId (path) — The Team identifier to perform the request on behalf of.
Optional: state (query) — The state of the flags to retrieve. Defaults to `active`.; limit (query) — Maximum number of flags to return.; cursor (query) — Pagination cursor to continue from.; search (query) — Search flags by their slug or description. Case-insensitive.; kind (query) — The kind of flags to retrieve.; tags (query) — Filter flags by tag. Repeat the parameter for multiple tags (all must match).; createdBy (query) — Filter flags by the id of the entity that created them (a user or team id).; maintainerIds (query) — Filter flags by maintainer user id. Repeat the parameter for multiple maintainers (any may match).; includeMarketplaceFlags (query) — Whether to include Marketplace experimentation items in the paginated response. Defaults to false.; slug (query) — The Team slug to perform the request on behalf of.

name: Update a Team
description: Update a Team Update the information of a Team specified by the `teamId` parameter. PATCH /v2/teams/{teamId}
context:
PATCH /v2/teams/{teamId}
Update the information of a Team specified by the `teamId` parameter. The request body should contain the information that will be updated on the Team.
Required: teamId (path) — The Team identifier to perform the request on behalf of.; body (body)
Optional: slug (query) — The Team slug to perform the request on behalf of.

name: Update Team Directory Sync Role Mappings
description: Update Team Directory Sync Role Mappings Update the Directory Sync role mappings for a Team. POST /v1/teams/{teamId}/dsync-roles
context:
POST /v1/teams/{teamId}/dsync-roles
Update the Directory Sync role mappings for a Team. This endpoint allows updating the mapping between directory groups and team roles or access groups.
Required: teamId (path) — The Team identifier to perform the request on behalf of.
Optional: slug (query) — The Team slug to perform the request on behalf of.; body (body)

name: Remove a Team Member
description: Remove a Team Member Remove a Team Member from the Team, or dismiss a user that requested access, or leave a team. DELETE /v1/teams/{teamId}/members/{uid}
context:
DELETE /v1/teams/{teamId}/members/{uid}
Remove a Team Member from the Team, or dismiss a user that requested access, or leave a team. Directory Sync members can be removed when their directory email is absent or does not match the user's primary or verified secondary emails.
Required: uid (path) — The user ID of the member.; teamId (path)
Optional: newDefaultTeamId (query) — The ID of the team to set as the new default team for the Northstar user.

name: Request access to a team
description: Request access to a team Request access to a team as a member. POST /v1/teams/{teamId}/request
context:
POST /v1/teams/{teamId}/request
Request access to a team as a member. An owner has to approve the request. Only 100 users can request access to a team at the same time.
Required: teamId (path); body (body)

name: Update a microfrontends group
description: Update a microfrontends group Updates a microfrontends group's settings. PATCH /v1/teams/{teamId}/microfrontends/{groupId}
context:
PATCH /v1/teams/{teamId}/microfrontends/{groupId}
Updates a microfrontends group's settings.
Required: groupId (path); teamId (path) — The Team identifier to perform the request on behalf of.
Optional: slug (query) — The Team slug to perform the request on behalf of.; body (body)

name: Update a Team Member
description: Update a Team Member Update the membership of a Team Member on the Team specified by `teamId`, such as changing the _role_ of the member, or confirming a request to join the Team for an unconfirmed member. PATCH /v1/teams/{teamId}/members/{uid}
